{{Youmay|the symbol of the [[Order of Dai Bendu]]|other uses of [[Bendu (disambiguation)|Bendu]]|linebreak=1}}
[[File:RepublicBenduSymbol-AoI.png|thumb|right|200px|Bendu Symbol]]
The '''Bendu symbol''' was the symbol of the [[Order of Dai Bendu]]. It was a circle connected by eight even spokes, which represented the unification of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Due to the Order of Dai Bendu study of numerology, the number eight created by this symbol had great meaning.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] used a six-spoked crest similar to the Bendu symbol.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> By the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had adopted the symbol<ref name="CCS" /> as the [[Republic crest/Legends|Republic crest]]<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref> to represent their own role in [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|galactic unification]].<ref name="CCS" /> A six-spoked form of the symbol was on [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Anakin's starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] immediately before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The symbol was later the basis for the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]].<ref name="CCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Bendu" may come from [[George Lucas]]'s original name for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]: the Jedi Bendu.<ref name="Rough Draft">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/the-star-wars-rough-draft|text=''The Star Wars: Rough Draft''|work=[https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller Starkiller — The Jedi Bendu Script Site]|archivedate=20240601042406}}</ref>
